result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so the example in the task gives Anna 2 and Bob 1.

- **Fix:** `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `countPurchaseOrdersIntoSalesRepRegionsPerSalesRep` (around line 6518). The purchase-order subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the per-quarter and latest-purchase-order queries use. Reps with no purchase orders still come back with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.
- **Test:** `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`. I added `ignoresCancelledPurchaseOrders`, which reproduces the task's example. I also gave the existing `purchaseOrder` helper a status overload so the test can create cancelled and received orders.

`mvn -q -o test -Dtest=SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes with no failures. I did not confirm that the new test fails without the fix. Nothing is committed.
